title: library.json
description: The library's settings and format version. Settings that belong to one device (reminders, UI state) are stored on that device, not here.
$comment: Like every library file: keys this version doesn't know are kept when the app rewrites the file.

schemaVersion.description: The format version, 3 at present. Adding optional fields keeps it; anything else is a new version, with a migration in the app. An app older than the library opens it read-only.

baseCurrency.description: The currency net worth is reported in, and plans run in.

taxResidence.description: The country you live in. It picks the default inflation index (inflationIndex).

mainPlan.description: The plan shown on the Overview. It's re-run at every check-in, and a baseline of it is saved at the first check-in of each year.

inflationIndex.description: The consumer price index amounts are put in today's money with and real returns computed with: an index of the history files' indices, hicp-<country> (a country's harmonised index, hicp-de, hicp-ch) or hicp-ea (the euro area's). Left out, it's worked out in this order: the HICP of taxResidence, when the country has one; else, of the indices in the base currency the library has values of, the one with the most; else the HICP of the base currency (the euro area's for EUR, Switzerland's for CHF); else none, and amounts stay in the money of their dates.
